q1_issues.issue: 'in three random ways' answers *how*, and the oblique rule assigns a named role whenever the PP answers where / when / how / whence / whither, so Manner is indicated rather than the preposition-named (In ...) fallback; the same slot is repeated inside the distribution rule at statement 10.

q2_gaps: an -ly adverb modifying an adjective ('algorithmically equivalent') - Compound concepts covers verb_object, verb_particle, modifier_noun, adjective+noun, possessive and agent-nominalization compounds, but no adverb+adjective compound, so the fused symbol and its genus are improvised

a symmetric / relational adjective used ATTRIBUTIVELY on a plural ('these equivalent sequences') - the plural-modifier rule distributes it as a one-place property of each member, losing the mutual relation, while Reciprocals & symmetric relations covers only copular predications
